transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… it’s about my eating at night. Sometimes I start picking at leftovers, and even when I’m telling myself, “That’s enough, Alejandro,” I just keep going back for more.
When you're going back for more food at night, do you feel like you can't stop yourself?
Yeah… I guess that’s what it feels like. I’ll tell myself to stop, but then I’m still reaching for more anyway.
Are you usually feeling stressed, anxious, or upset when you start eating at night?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid much attention to that part. Maybe sometimes, but I’m not sure.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating when you're having these late-night snacks?
Not really, no. I mean… part of me knows I should stop, but once I start with the leftovers, I just keep reaching for more anyway.
Do you usually feel guilty after eating all those leftovers at night?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think about it much after… maybe I just try not to.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time during these late-night snacks?

Yeah… sometimes. Like after supper, if I’m putting away the tamales or mole, I’ll keep taking more than I should. A few servings, maybe some pan dulce too. I wouldn’t pile that much on a plate in front of everyone.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control and eaten a large amount of food in a very short period of time?
Yeah… I guess that’s what it feels like. Once I start picking at the leftovers late at night, I’ll think, “That’s enough, Alejandro,” but then my hand just keeps going back anyway.
Are you usually eating at night because you're feeling bored, stressed, or upset?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s boredom or stress. It’s just… nighttime, and the food is there.
Do you feel like you're eating at night out of habit or because you feel an strong urge to eat?
More like an urge, I guess. Or… once I start, it’s hard to stop. I’ll tell myself, “that’s enough, Alejandro,” but my hand still keeps going back.
Do you usually feel guilty after these episodes of eating a large amount of food at night?
I’m not sure I’d call it guilt exactly. I don’t feel great about it, but… I don’t really sit there thinking it through much.
Are you usually hungry when you start eating those leftovers at night?
Not usually, no. I mean, I’ve already eaten dinner with everyone most nights. But later I’ll still end up opening the containers… just tasting one thing, then another.
Do you think you're eating at night because you're physically hungry?
No… not really. I usually had a decent dinner already. It’s more that later I end up opening the containers anyway, just having a little of this and that.
When you're eating those leftovers at night, do you find yourself eating faster than you would during a regular meal?
I haven’t really noticed. I don’t think about the speed much when it’s happening… I’m just kind of picking at things.
When you're eating those leftovers at night, do you usually do it alone or do others know you're eating?
Usually alone. I kind of wait until the house is quiet… or I’ll go out to the garage. I wouldn’t want my cousin or the family seeing how much I’m eating. It’s embarrassing, I guess.
When you're eating those leftovers at night, do you find yourself eating really quickly?
I’m not sure. I mean… I don’t think of it as eating really quickly. I’m usually just standing there picking at stuff, so I haven’t paid much attention to that.
When you're eating those leftovers at night, do you feel like you're eating quickly?
I don’t really know. I haven’t paid attention to whether it’s quick… it just sort of happens.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly when you're having those late-night snacks?
I… I really don’t know. I haven’t paid attention to the speed of it, honestly.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly when you're having those late-night snacks?
I honestly still can’t say. I don’t really notice the pace when it’s happening.
Do you feel like you're eating really quickly when you're having those late-night snacks?
I know you’re asking, but… I still don’t really have a good answer. I’m not watching the clock or anything when it happens.
Do you feel like you're in control of how much you're eating when you're having these late-night snacks?
Not really, no. Once I start picking at the leftovers, part of me is saying, “that’s enough, Alejandro,” but I still keep reaching for more.
